newsitem.title: USA: Hirsch files for 1.9 million Class A shrs.
newsitem.headline: Hirsch files for 1.9 million Class A shrs.

text.p: Hirsch International Corp filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 1,853,946 Class A common shares.
Of the total amount, 1,210,526 common will be sold by the company and 643,420 common will be offered by certain stockholders. After the offering, outstanding shares will total 9,255,441 common.
The selling stockholders have granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 278,092 additional shares, the filing said.
The offering will be made through Robertson, Stephens & Co, the Robinson-Humphrey Co Inc and Janney Montgomery Scott Inc.
Net proceeds will be used for repayment of acquisition debt, establishment and operation of Tajima Industries Ltd embroidery machine assembly facility and general corporate purposes.
Hirsch, based in Hauppauge, N.Y., is a single source provider to the embroidery industry of electronic computer-controlled embroidery machinery and related value-added products and services.
